sipe.definition:
v. i. To run or soak through fine pores and interstices; to
   ooze.

siphon.definition:
n. a tube running from the liquid in a vessel to a lower level outside the vessel so that atmospheric pressure forces the liquid through the tube
n. a tubular organ in an aquatic animal (especially in mollusks) through which water can be taken in or expelled
v. convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon
v. move a liquid from one container into another by means of a siphon or a siphoning action
siphon.translation:
n. 虹吸管
vt. 用虹吸管吸出, 抽取
vi. 通过虹吸管

siphon tubes.translation: [医] 虹吸管; 呼吸管(昆虫)

siphonage.definition: n. The action of a siphon.
siphonage.translation:
n. 虹吸作用
[医] 虹吸法

siphonal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a siphon; resembling a siphon.
siphonal.translation: a. 虹吸管的, 虹吸管状的

siphonata.definition:
n. pl. A tribe of bivalve mollusks in which the posterior
   mantle border is prolonged into two tubes or siphons. Called also
   Siphoniata. See Siphon, 2 (a), and Quahaug.

siphonate.definition:
a. Having a siphon or siphons.
a. Belonging to the Siphonata.

siphonaxanthin.translation: 管藻黄质, 管藻黄素

v convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon

siphoned.translation: v. 用虹吸管吸（或输送）（液体）( siphon的过去式和过去分词 )

siphonet.definition:
n. One of the two dorsal tubular organs on the hinder part
   of the abdomen of aphids. They give exit to the honeydew. See Illust.
   under Aphis.

siphonic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a siphon.
siphonic.translation: a. 虹吸管的, 虹吸管状的

siphoning.definition:
v convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon
v move a liquid from one container into another by means of a siphon or a siphoning action
siphoning.translation: v. 用虹吸管吸（或输送）（液体）( siphon的现在分词 )

siphonium.definition:
n. A bony tube which, in some birds, connects the tympanium
   with the air chambers of the articular piece of the mandible.

siphonophore.definition: n. a floating or swimming oceanic colony of polyps often transparent or showily colored

siphonopoda.definition:
n. pl. A division of Scaphopoda including those in which
   the foot terminates in a circular disk.

siphonostomata.definition:
n. pl. A tribe of parasitic copepod Crustacea
   including a large number of species that are parasites of fishes, as
   the lerneans. They have a mouth adapted to suck blood.
n. pl. An artificial division of gastropods including
   those that have siphonostomatous shells.

siphonostomatous.definition:
a. Having the front edge of the aperture of the
   shell prolonged in the shape of a channel for the protection of the
   siphon; -- said of certain gastropods.
a. Pertaining to the Siphonostomata.

siphons.definition:
n a tube running from the liquid in a vessel to a lower level outside the vessel so that atmospheric pressure forces the liquid through the tube
n a tubular organ in an aquatic animal (especially in mollusks) through which water can be taken in or expelled
v convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon
